svg.title: Eregion & the Gates of Moria
svg.desc: Eregion is west of the mountain barrier; Dimrill Dale is east. The dotted crossing beneath Khazad-dûm is underground and schematic. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: Hollin · the Redhorn Gate · Dimrill Dale
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
